invariants.description: u = u_0 + K ((q/q0)^m - (q/q0)^n) + u_ext + K_visco (inflow - outflow), q0 = pi r0^2 l (for m = 1/2, n = 0: u - u_0 - u_ext = K (sqrt(A/A0) - 1))
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs((u) - (u_0 + K_tube*((q/(np.pi*r_0**2*l))**m_tube - (q/(np.pi*r_0**2*l))**n_tube) + u_ext + K_tube_visco*(v - (v_out_1 + v_out_2))))) <= 1e-08*(np.max(np.abs(u)) + np.max(np.abs(u_0 + K_tube*((q/(np.pi*r_0**2*l))**m_tube - (q/(np.pi*r_0**2*l))**n_tube) + u_ext + K_tube_visco*(v - (v_out_1 + v_out_2))))) + 1e-30

invariants.description: du_dt = K (m q^(m-1)/q0^m - n q^(n-1)/q0^n) (v - outflow) (chain rule of the elastic tube law)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs((du_dt) - (K_tube*(m_tube*q**(m_tube - 1)/(np.pi*r_0**2*l)**m_tube - n_tube*q**(n_tube - 1)/(np.pi*r_0**2*l)**n_tube)*(v - (v_out_1 + v_out_2))))) <= 1e-08*(np.max(np.abs(du_dt)) + np.max(np.abs(K_tube*(m_tube*q**(m_tube - 1)/(np.pi*r_0**2*l)**m_tube - n_tube*q**(n_tube - 1)/(np.pi*r_0**2*l)**n_tube)*(v - (v_out_1 + v_out_2))))) + 1e-30

invariants.description: integrating du_dt reproduces the elastic pressure: u - K_visco (v - outflow) (trapezoidal integral on the output grid from t = 0.0004 s, 5% of its range)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(((u - K_tube_visco*(v - (v_out_1 + v_out_2))))[t >= 0.0004] - ((u - K_tube_visco*(v - (v_out_1 + v_out_2))))[t >= 0.0004][0] - np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*((du_dt + 0*t)[(t >= 0.0004)][1:] + (du_dt + 0*t)[(t >= 0.0004)][:-1])*np.diff(t[(t >= 0.0004)])))))) <= 5e-2*np.ptp(((u - K_tube_visco*(v - (v_out_1 + v_out_2))))[t >= 0.0004]) + 1e-6*np.max(np.abs((u - K_tube_visco*(v - (v_out_1 + v_out_2))))) + 1e-9

invariants.description: volume balance: d(q)/dt = (v) - (v_out_1 + v_out_2) (trapezoidal integral of the flows from t = 0.0004 s, rel. tol 0.05)
steady state at t_end: v = v_out_1 + v_out_2
steady state at t_end: u = u_in - R (v_out_1 + v_out_2) - gravity term
q stays positive (the tube law needs a positive volume)

bc_sweep.rationale: Boundary conditions span physiological operating values for the vessel class (arterial inlet 60-150 mmHg, venous 0-15 mmHg, flows 0-2x the nominal flow; +-0.5% for the nonlinear vv types, whose volume drifts by (v_in - v_out) t and collapses the tube if the imbalance is larger); constants are swept 0.5-2x their value; rho and mu are swept 0.5-2x their library (test_fft fixture) value of 1; beta_g 0-1; g 1-9.81; the wall-thickness constants a-d between the fixture value 1 and the proposed Blanco 2015 values. The physiological rho/mu (1050, 0.004) cannot yet be combined with the others at the run point (framework issue), so the swept regime is the library one. Excluded: tube-law exponents (they define the law), switches (R_flag, blood_ctl_dir).

baseline.reason: a single vessel under constant boundary conditions has no measured counterpart; validation needs a network assembled from these modules. Candidate: the Boileau et al. (2015) benchmark reference solutions (e.g. the aortic-bifurcation and 37-artery test cases, whose 1D reference pressure/flow waveforms are published as supplementary data), compared with a chain of these 0D segments (proposal only, not set up).
